title: Thy Mighty Word Commanding
description: Thy Mighty Word Commanding in Tonic Solfa to ST. ALPHEGE, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904), headed “Ode VIII of Metrophanes”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sevens and Sixes (7.6.7.6), and this page sets them to ST. ALPHEGE; any other Sevens and Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thy might-y word com-mand-ing, The hea-vens were settled high, And earth to Thee re-spond-ing Was spread be-neath the sky.

lines: O God of power, Thy servants
That they their hearts to love Thee
Our souls shall feast with gladness
From age to age Thy servants
Shall hymn both day and night.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to ST. ALPHEGE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
